VINDEX

/About Vindex

Vision. Voice. Value.
Your champion on social media

Vindex is my own brand. I built it from scratch: the name, the Triple V mark, the colors, the type system and an 82-page brand book. Through it, I help founders and small business owners with marketing and growth.

The name holds three ideas. Vindex is Latin for champion: the one who stands up for someone. It holds my name, Vin, because a real person does the work. And it holds index: everything is researched and measured.

I work as one person in your corner, not an agency. I research first, build the plan around your goals and report honestly. Clients can hire me for one service or several, in any industry except legal, at any stage.

SERVICES

/Services

The Vindex packages come first. Below them is the work I've delivered for freelance clients, tagged by the industry it was for.

  • Vision · Content Strategy: market research, content strategy, content ideas and a monthly calendar
  • Voice · Content Creation: reels, reel covers, carousels and stories; the client provides the footage
  • Value · Social Media Management: scheduling and posting, tracking trends and the algorithm, and analytics
  • Engagement add-on: daily engagement sessions, or a campaign toward a set follower target
  • The Triple V: Vision, Voice and Value together, in one package
  • Publication research across beauty, wellness, business, culture, DEI and textured-hair advocacy
  • A database of 40+ target publications with editor contacts, submission channels, notes and pitch angles
  • Verifying contacts, emails, links and submission routes before anything is sent
  • Publication-specific pitch frameworks and follow-up drafts
  • TV and producer outreach through booking channels and portal forms
  • Artist booking proposals for a festival, sent from the client's inbox on the founder's template, with DM and email follow-ups
  • Speaking opportunities in technology, innovation, women in leadership, DEI and beauty
  • Award research, outreach drafting, sending and tracking
  • Separate trackers for media and for speaking
  • Brand foundations: audience personas, voice and messaging guidelines, sample copy
  • Visual brand guidelines decks in Canva: logo, color, typography, voice and application
  • Logo systems and wordmark directions, refined in rounds with the founder
  • Children's card sets designed with AI design prompts I write (exact hex codes, explicit constraints, reference files)
  • PDF post-processing for correct print trim and a clean logo slot
  • HTML mockups with interactive 3D elements, plus a Figma-ready design spec
  • Custom HTML, CSS and JavaScript inside a site builder, coded with Claude
  • Copy rewritten to a founder's claims audit: no unsupported superlatives or stats, planned features marked "in development", legal references qualified by jurisdiction
  • Recap reels of 10–20 seconds cut from past event footage
  • Copy briefs with hook variations, on-screen overlays, caption and hashtag sets and multi-scene video sequences
  • Niche market research and analysis of comparable accounts
  • Launch plans turned into status checklists, with legal and founder items flagged
  • Drafting DM and inquiry replies, routing them to the company inbox, and standard reply templates
  • Status updates, follow-ups, email and admin support for founders

Website mockup, build & claims rewrite

ChallengeBuild the startup's website inside its site builder, with copy that holds up to the founder's own audit. What I didI made an HTML mockup with 3D interactive elements and a Figma-ready design spec, then built the site with custom HTML, CSS and JavaScript coded with Claude, merging 10 separate sections into one block with a custom sticky navigation. I rewrote all copy and claims to match the audit. When a site-builder plan restriction blocked edits, I diagnosed it and escalated it to the founder.
